Infrastructure Specialist-Cloud Platforms
description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As an Infrastructure Specialist for Cloud Platforms, you will manage and implement infrastructure solutions across various cloud environments according to established designs, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security. You will collaborate with IT teams to implement and integrate cloud infrastructure solutions based on existing designs.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Set Up and Configure Cloud Infrastructure: Set up, configure, and manage virtual machines, storage solutions, networking, and databases across different cloud platforms to effectively support business applications.
* Implement and Oversee Cloud Resources: Implement and oversee essential cloud resources such as Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs), Load Balancers, and Cloud Storage solutions to ensure smooth operations.
* Monitor and Troubleshoot Infrastructure: Continuously monitor infrastructure, troubleshoot issues, and maintain high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) configurations to ensure reliable performance.
* Apply Security Measures: Apply and enforce security measures to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with organizational policies and industry regulations.
* Optimize Cloud Costs: Optimize cloud costs by right\-sizing resources, developing cost\-effective solutions, and monitoring usage patterns.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Cloud Services Proficiency: Exposure to cloud services from providers such as Oracle Cloud, Nutanix Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, and others, with expertise in Linux and VMware environments.
* Automation Tools Experience: Exposure to automation tools like Terraform, Ansible, and native cloud automation services to automate and streamline processes.
* Cloud Migration Project Experience: Experience with cloud migration projects, including implementation and execution, with a focus on effective planning and delivery.
* Kubernetes Cluster Management: Proficiency in managing Kubernetes clusters across various cloud environments for effective container orchestration and scaling.
* DevOps Practices Knowledge: Exposure to DevOps practices, such as continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), with an understanding of their application in cloud infrastructure management.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Cloud Cost Optimization Techniques: Exposure to methods for optimizing cloud costs, including right\-sizing resources, developing cost\-effective solutions, and monitoring usage patterns to minimize expenses.
* Advanced Cloud Security Measures: Experience with implementing and enforcing advanced security measures to ensure cloud infrastructure compliance with organizational policies and industry regulations.
* Multi\-Cloud Environment Expertise: Exposure to managing and implementing infrastructure solutions across multiple cloud environments, including Oracle Cloud, Nutanix Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, and others.

title: Technical Consultant-AI Integration
description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As a Technical Consultant specializing in AI Integration, you will implement, configure, and customize AI\-driven solutions that integrate seamlessly into enterprise applications and workflows. This role requires translating solution designs and architectural blueprints into working systems, ensuring secure, efficient, and compliant deployment of AI services, APIs, and orchestration layers.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Implement AI Solutions: Develop connectors, build Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and configure prompts and guardrails to integrate AI services into enterprise applications and workflows.
* Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with architects, data engineers, and business stakeholders to validate requirements, deliver proofs of concept, and harden solutions for production.
* Optimize Performance: Implement observability, performance tuning, and cost optimization measures to ensure reliable and scalable AI solutions.
* Ensure Compliance: Deploy AI services, APIs, and orchestration layers in compliance with organizational and regulatory standards.
* Deliver Solutions: Translate solution designs and architectural blueprints into working systems, focusing on reliability, scalability, and responsible AI principles throughout the delivery lifecycle.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Exposure to API Integration: Hands\-on experience with integrating AI services and APIs into enterprise applications and workflows, including developing connectors and configuring prompts and guardrails.
* Experience with Workflow Automation: Familiarity with workflow automation and event\-driven patterns, including building Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and implementing orchestration layers.
* LLMOps Practices: Exposure to LLMOps practices, including implementing observability, performance tuning, and cost optimization measures to ensure reliable and scalable AI solutions.
* Secure Deployment: Experience with deploying AI services, APIs, and orchestration layers in compliance with organizational and regulatory standards, ensuring secure and efficient deployment.
* AI Solution Development: Experience working with AI solution designs and architectural blueprints, translating them into working systems that integrate seamlessly into enterprise applications and workflows.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Workflow Automation Expertise: Familiarity with workflow automation and event\-driven patterns, including building Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and implementing orchestration layers, is beneficial for this role.
* LLMOps Practices Knowledge: Exposure to LLMOps practices, including implementing observability, performance tuning, and cost optimization measures, is advantageous for ensuring reliable and scalable AI solutions.
* Secure Deployment Experience: Experience with deploying AI services, APIs, and orchestration layers in compliance with organizational and regulatory standards is desirable, ensuring secure and efficient deployment.
